identify_parameter: identify normalization parameters for a feature including box-cox transformation, quantiles, mean, and standard deviation
get_feature_norm_metadata: get normalization metadata for a feature by analyzing its value list with configurable override parameters
sort_features_by_normalization: sort features by their normalization type and return the sorted list with feature start indices
construct_action_scale_tensor: construct min and max action range tensors for rescaling action values from serving range to training range
serialize_deserialize: serialize normalization parameters to JSON or deserialize them back into NormalizationParameters objects
